zoning-land-use.title: Real Estate Transactions
zoning-land-use.headline: Real estate transactions.
zoning-land-use.intro: Property acquisitions, disposals and leases bring legal rights, documentation and commercial objectives together. Civantis examines those elements in the context of the transaction.

topics.title: Before commitment
topics.body: Review the property, parties, available records and material conditions before contractual commitments are made.

topics.title: Agreements and obligations
topics.body: Consider sale and conveyance documentation, commercial leases, representations, covenants and allocation of risk.

topics.title: Completion
topics.body: Identify conditions precedent, outstanding documents and contractual steps relevant to completion.

development-feasibility.title: Development & Joint Ventures
development-feasibility.headline: Development agreements and joint ventures.
development-feasibility.intro: Development arrangements depend on a clear understanding of land rights, contributions, responsibilities and the commercial expectations of the parties.

topics.title: Development arrangements
topics.body: Consider joint development agreements, landowner–developer arrangements and the allocation of development rights.

topics.title: Delivery and economics
topics.body: Examine milestones, capital obligations, dependencies and the relationship between contractual commitments and project feasibility.

topics.title: Managing change
topics.body: Review mechanisms for delay, variation, default, termination and exit in the context of the agreement.

regulatory-approvals.title: Regulatory & RERA Matters
regulatory-approvals.headline: The regulatory context of development.
regulatory-approvals.intro: Real estate development engages statutory obligations, administrative processes and relationships between promoters and purchasers. The applicable framework depends on the project and jurisdiction.

topics.title: Project requirements
topics.body: Identify the applicable statutory framework, project documentation and issues relevant to registration or compliance.

topics.title: Promoter and allottee matters
topics.body: Consider agreements, disclosures, contractual obligations and the relationship between the parties.

topics.title: Regulatory correspondence
topics.body: Review notices, responses, documentary requirements and the sequencing of relevant authority processes.

building-regulations.title: Land Use & Planning Law
building-regulations.headline: Land use and planning law.
building-regulations.intro: The legal status of land and its development potential are shaped by planning designations, statutory controls and the characteristics of the site.

topics.title: Planning framework
topics.body: Examine master plans, zoning, permitted uses and the applicable development control framework.

topics.title: Development potential
topics.body: Consider building restrictions, land-use change, infrastructure requirements and the interaction between planning and project feasibility.

topics.title: Implementation
topics.body: Identify the relevant authority processes and legal questions that need to be resolved before development decisions progress.

land-due-diligence.title: Title & Property Due Diligence
land-due-diligence.headline: Title and property due diligence.
land-due-diligence.intro: A property decision requires an understanding of the rights that can be transferred, the interests affecting them and the reliability of the underlying records.

topics.title: Ownership history
topics.body: Examine the chain of title and relevant land, revenue and registration records.

topics.title: Third-party interests
topics.body: Review encumbrances, easements, possession issues, contractual rights and material discrepancies.

topics.title: Transaction implications
topics.body: Identify gaps in information, further documentary requirements and implications for contractual safeguards or conditions.

urban-planning.title: Property Disputes & Resolution
urban-planning.headline: Property disputes and resolution.
urban-planning.intro: Property disputes often arise from differing interpretations of rights, contracts, obligations or the circumstances of development and occupation.

topics.title: Assess the position
topics.body: Establish the relevant agreements, chronology, documentary evidence and competing positions.

topics.title: Evaluate options
topics.body: Consider contractual remedies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration or other appropriate dispute mechanisms in context.

topics.title: Commercial implications
topics.body: Examine the implications of delay, cost and uncertainty for the parties and the property concerned.

experience.title: Professional Scope
experience.headline: The scope of our practice.
experience.intro: The scope of Civantis’s practice ranges from property transactions and development arrangements to regulatory questions and disputes. The areas below describe types of matters, rather than completed client engagements.

topics.title: Transactions and title
topics.body: Property acquisitions, ownership investigations, commercial leasing and contractual documentation.

topics.title: Development and regulation
topics.body: Joint development arrangements, statutory requirements, planning controls and development feasibility.

topics.title: Disputes and risk
topics.body: Property and contractual disagreements, construction-related issues and assessment of potential resolution pathways.
